plugins.name: squad
plugins.description: A maintenance squad for any product: a measurement-first pipeline (BRAINSTORM → DESIGN → BACKLOG → DISCOVER → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → CODE-QUALITY → REVIEW → RELEASE → ACCEPTANCE) where every item is a hypothesis, evidence comes from your own code and runtime, and killing an item is a successful outcome. Domain specialists are derived from your repositories, never shipped.
plugins.author: Paulo Henrique
